title: CIF-Bench: A Chinese Instruction-Following Benchmark for Evaluating the Generalizability of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus was on zero-shot generalizability of LLMs to the Chinese language, covering complex reasoning, Chinese cultural nuances, and general NLP capabilities.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the research.
